newsitem.title: UK: Coral bookmaker shortens odds on UK Labour victory.
newsitem.headline: Coral bookmaker shortens odds on UK Labour victory.

text.p: British bookmaker Coral said on Monday that after heavy betting on the opposition Labour Party it was shortening its odds on a Labour election victory to 1-7 from 1-6.
Odds on a win for the ruling Conservatives were lengthened to 4-1 from 7-2, Coral said.
"Labour has been heavily backed today to win the most seats at Thursday's general election," the company said in a statement.
Earlier, bookmakers William Hill cut the odds of Labour emerging as the biggest party to 1-9.

"Labour are now the hottest favourites they have ever been to win a general election, with the Tories at longer odds than have been offered about them since they came to power," William Hill spokesman Graham Sharpe said.
